hypothesis: Temporarily deprioritize a grounded non-progress entry while other model-plausible entries remain; revisit after alternatives are also deferred.
order: control then policy, fresh browser context each
modelBoundary: Policy state and weights not injected into gateway input; only admitted existing experience and images. No human feedback/route, DOM/oracle, scripted correct target, or stored-input resubmission.
outcomes: Raw argmax vs corrected chosen action using the same saved raw distribution
Actual post-return branch change, not a different link to same destination
Alternative exploration vs direct success vs subjective completion vs objective goal
Release when all plausible alternatives deferred, retaining positive revisit mass
limitsOfInference: One fresh run per condition is not a causal estimate, rate, or human validation. The policy is an explicit configurable heuristic, not evidence Jev understood history. Exact-image identity can miss a same page after scrolling.
